scenes.title: Thirty-Five Minutes
scenes.summary: Ernesto panics over the double-booked room while Mateo unlocks the third-floor staircase.

scenes.title: The Sunny Attic
scenes.summary: Up in the quiet attic room, Clara, Mateo, and Rocio inspect the space and list what is missing.

scenes.title: Left at the Landing
scenes.summary: Clara, Rocio, and Ernesto finish making the bed, plug in the warm lamp, and hear the front gate bell.

scenes.title: In from the Rain
scenes.summary: Quiet architect Javier arrives soaked from the rain, and Clara and Rocio warm him up before explaining the room change.

scenes.title: Half Price and Quiet Beams
scenes.summary: Shown the cozy attic room at half price, Javier admires the timber ceiling and happily takes the key.

scenes.title: A Five-Star Sigh of Relief
scenes.summary: Downstairs Ernesto celebrates the solved double-booking until Clara spots a small leather notebook left on the counter.

scenes.title: Returning the Notebook
scenes.summary: Clara returns Javier's leather notebook and hears the radiator pipe clank and go lukewarm.

scenes.title: Ice-Cold Pipes
scenes.summary: Coming up from the cellar, Mateo delivers bad news: the hot-water boiler valve just cracked for the night.
